{
  "name": "ruflo-protector",
  "description": "Project Anatole: an optional, learning watchdog for unattended agents. Deterministic OWASP-mapped rules, a per-project behavioural baseline, four modes (off, learn, notify, enforce), alerts you can read later.",
  "version": "0.1.1",
  "author": {
    "name": "ruvnet",
    "url": "https://github.com/ruvnet"
  },
  "homepage": "https://github.com/ruvnet/ruflo",
  "license": "MIT",
  "keywords": [
    "ruflo",
    "anatole",
    "protector",
    "watchdog",
    "security",
    "owasp",
    "baseline",
    "unattended",
    "mod",
    "function-hooks"
  ],
  "userConfig": {
    "mode": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Project Anatole mode",
      "description": "off: do nothing. learn (default): record the baseline and say nothing. notify: alert, never block. enforce: rules marked block deny. A mode set with /protector mode overrides this.",
      "required": false,
      "default": "learn",
      "options": [
        "off",
        "learn",
        "notify",
        "enforce"
      ]
    },
    "autoGraduate": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Graduate learn to notify",
      "description": "When the baseline is mature (200 events, 3 sessions, 24 hours), move learn to notify. Never moves to enforce.",
      "required": false,
      "default": "on",
      "options": [
        "on",
        "off"
      ]
    }
  }
}
